name: RNGLR parser implementation with cycle handling

mentions.name: RNGLR parser implementation with cycle handling
mentions.description: An implementation of RNGLR, a polynomial-time parser for any context-free grammar, running as a table-based interpreter and extended with special code to handle grammar cycles more efficiently.
mentions.problem: Grammar cycles are handled inefficiently in table-based parser interpreters.
mentions.source_excerpt: I have an RNGLR implementation (a polynomial-time parser for any context-free grammar), that's still a table-based interpreter like more LR-based parsers out there. I've extended that implementation with special code to handle cycles more efficiently.

evidence.value: I have an RNGLR implementation (a polynomial-time parser for any context-free grammar), that's still a table-based interpreter like more LR-based parsers out there. I've extended that implementation with special code to handle cycles more efficiently.
